strategy: Reviewed exact-text replacements applied to the pinned SPC v3 source after its archive digest is verified. Each patch pins the digest of the whole file before and after, so a changed upstream file fails instead of being silently rewritten.

patches.reason: Duplicate clang_rt.crtbegin/crtend objects break every shared C++ extension link under Zig; the wrapper must not append a second copy when the caller already passes one.

replace.new:
if [[ $NEED_CRT -eq 1 && -f "$RT_DIR/clang_rt.crtbegin.o" && -f "$RT_DIR/clang_rt.crtend.o" ]]; then
        # libtool's C++ tag records whatever objects this compiler adds to a -shared probe in
        # postdep_objects and passes them on every later link. Appending a second copy here
        # duplicates __dso_handle and __EH_FRAME_LIST_END__, so ld.lld aborts the link
        # ("duplicate symbol: __dso_handle" while linking ext/intl). Inject only when absent.
        HAVE_CRT=0
        for _arg in "${PARSED_ARGS[@]}"; do
            case "$_arg" in
                *clang_rt.crtbegin.o|*clang_rt.crtend.o) HAVE_CRT=1 ;;
            esac
        done
        [[ $HAVE_CRT -eq 0 ]] && PARSED_ARGS+=("-x" "none" "$RT_DIR/clang_rt.crtbegin.o" "$RT_DIR/clang_rt.crtend.o")
    fi

patches.reason: phpize omits the configure LIBS environment from final module links, leaving unwind, C++ and libzip transitive symbols unresolved. Append the resolved non-PHP static dependency closure to each module's SHARED_LIBADD, with archive grouping, before make.
